subject: Recap & procurement framing — Redwood + Greenleaf Health (next steps)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@greenleafhealth.com>; Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & procurement framing — Redwood + Greenleaf Health (next steps)

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned while you land internal approvals. I tried to keep this concise — flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you called out
- High-latency diagnosis summarization in your provider portal (5–7s per request today) impacting clinician workflow.
- Rising per-request cost for batch batch/triage workloads as volume grows (projected 3x in 12 months).
- Security & auditability needs: event-level logs, tenant separation, and KMS integration.

Current stack / environment
- On-prem EHR + Azure-hosted analytics. Core NLP services currently run as a mix of managed cloud functions and a vendor-hosted API (legacy).
- HIPAA-sensitive PHI flows through the portal; all providers are within the US.

Success criteria you described
- 80% reduction in tail latency for portal summarization (target p95 < 1.2s).
- Stable per-token cost that scales predictably with throughput (target < $X per 1k tokens — we will flesh out exact pricing on next call).
- SOC2-ready audit trail and integration with your existing KMS.

Procurement & decision process (what we understood)
- Decision committee: Samir (CTO), Elena (Head of Product), plus Procurement (cc'd).
- Timeline: target decision for pilot next 6–8 weeks; production roll-out target for Q4 2026.
- Procurement guardrails: likely a PO-based purchase with Net30 payment terms; initial pilot budget range you indicated ~$40k–$75k committed for dedicated capacity or reserved throughput.

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) We’ll send a short pilot SOW + commercial guardrail draft by Friday (Jonas / Marissa).
2) Marissa to schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with your infra/NLP engineer to walk integration options and latency tuning (proposed week of Jul 27).
3) Samir / Procurement: please confirm the primary procurement contact and any standard legal clauses you need us to surface early (e.g., data residency, indemnity thresholds).
4) Redwood will provide a short security checklist and SOC2 evidence package; Marissa to attach initial artifacts.

Attachments we will include in the follow-up: Redwood pilot SOW template, short SOC2 evidence summary, example performance profile for the model family we discussed.

If the timeline looks right, I’ll lock Marissa and the tech deep-dive for Jul 28 — otherwise tell me which days work.

Thanks again — enjoyed the discussion.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0194
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: redwood-sow-template-v1.pdf (pilot SOW, 3 pages), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (1 page)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@greenleafhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & procurement framing — Redwood + Greenleaf Health (next steps)

Jonas — thanks for the crisp recap. This matches our notes. A couple of clarifications from procurement and product: 

- Procurement (procurement@greenleafhealth.com) will lead the PO and legal intake. Their primary contact is Linda Zhao (copied on a separate thread).
- We prefer Net30 but will flag any vendor exceptions. Please include standard redline-friendly language; we will route to legal once we have the SOW + sample T&Cs.
- For success metrics: Elena to confirm the exact p95 target internally; the p95 <1.2s is a good starting target.

Samir: for the technical deep-dive, our infra team prefers afternoons next week (EST). Can you propose two 60-min slots?

Two quick asks for Redwood:
1) Draft SOW + commercial guardrail that assumes a 6–8 week pilot and includes an option to convert to a reserved capacity contract.
2) Short answers to our RFX spreadsheet questions — we sent a draft earlier today (attached). If you can populate rows 1–8, that helps speed our internal eval.

I’ll pull Linda into this thread once Procurement confirms her calendar.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Product — Provider Experience
Greenleaf Health
elena.rossi@greenleafhealth.com | +1 617-555-0112

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & procurement framing — Redwood + Greenleaf Health (next steps)

Elena — jumping in with the technical / security bits you asked for.

1) Technical deep-dive scope (what I’ll cover)
- Integration patterns: REST vs gRPC, on-prem connector options, and EHR proxy patterns.
- Latency tuning: batching controls, KV cache recommendations, and model variants for p95 sizing.
- Security: KMS/HSM integration, tenant isolation options, and audit log export (syslog/S3).

2) RFX draft: I started populating rows 1–8 in your spreadsheet and attached the draft (greenleaf-rfx-answers-draft.xlsx). It has short, citation-style answers and references for SOC2 sections.

3) SOC2 evidence: attached is a 1-page summary and we can provide full artifacts under an NDA — let me know if Procurement needs a formal MSA/NDA before we share.

Proposed slots for the technical deep-dive (all EST):
- Tue Jul 28, 1:00–2:00pm
- Wed Jul 29, 3:00–4:00pm

If either looks good pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite + agenda.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 206-555-0133

Thanks — Procurement here (Linda Zhao).

We received the RFX draft and the SOW template from Jonas' note and have a couple of logistics notes for you: 
- Please include an explicit data handling addendum and our standard DPA language if possible.
- We will aim to complete commercial review within 7–10 business days after we receive the SOW + sample T&Cs.
- PO process: we require a line-item budget and a primary contact for invoicing (please provide name + billing email).

We have reviewed the initial budget guardrail you suggested (~$40k-$75k) and that is within the range Procurement expects for a pilot. For planning, please include both a pilot and a 12-month reserved capacity price band in the SOW (separate appendices).

Attach: our RFx intake spreadsheet (filled with checklist). We will sync internally and circle back with any redlines.

Linda Zhao
